title: Rafael and the Deadline
author: Odile Okafor
blurb: Theo Thornbury, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
